_comment: Story lines: id -> list of {who, mood, text}. who: maya, hajurama, bhai, kanchha, sunita, biralo. mood: neutral, happy, laugh, surprised, worried, grumpy. All text goes through the translation system (data/i18n).

intro.text: Maya nani! You came home! Look at you, all grown up.
Hajurama... the shop. The jars are all mixed up, and everything is so dusty.
Ke garne, babu. My knees aren't what they were. The old pasal needs young hands.
Then it has mine. Every jar I sort, the shop gets a little brighter. Promise!

a1.arrive.text: Right. One star, one fix. Where do I start?

a1.clean_counter.text: Ramro! I can see the wood again!
Your Hajurba built that counter. He'd be proud, nani.

a1.sweep_floor.text: Whoa, Didi! The floor isn't sticky anymore!
Because someone stopped dropping toffees on it. Right, Bhai?

a1.fix_shelf.text: Every jar back in its place. Twelve flavours, all in a row.
Biralo, that is not a bed. Get out of the Lapsi jar.

a1.hang_lights.text: Kanchha Dai at your service! Wires, bulbs, anything electric.
...Why is the switch on the ceiling? Never mind. Fixed!

a1.counter_jars.text: Customers will see the sweets the moment they walk in.

a1.cash_box.text: Oho, my lucky cash box! Thirty years and it still rattles.
Hajurama, there's a coin in here from before I was born!

a1.paint_walls.text: Maya! I could smell the paint from my tea stall. It looks wonderful!
Thanks, Sunita Didi. Come by for sweets later!

a1.fix_window.text: The mountains! I forgot you could see them from in here.
On clear mornings they shine like sugar, babu.

a1.garland.text: I picked the flowers! Well, most of them. Biralo ate one.

a1.wall_sign.text: My old sign! I painted those letters myself, before your mother was born.
Then it goes right where everyone can see it.

a1.stool.text: Finally, somewhere to sit while I tell you the news!
Didi, it's only been fixed for one minute...

a1.brass_scale.text: A fair scale makes a happy customer. Remember that, nani.

a1.outro.text: Is this... my shop? It looks like the day we opened.
Better, Hajurama. The jars are sorted and the lights are on.
Can we open the front now? The shutter is SO rusty.
Rusty shutters are my specialty! Mostly.
Then let's go outside. Chiya Tole needs to know we're open!
